name: Smoke test
prompt: Run a smoke test on {{URL}}. Check for page structure, content issues like mispellings or typos, grammar in general, FrontEnd best practices, responsive design, accessibility using the WCAG AA standard, make sure there are no broken links. Create a report on the findings, what passed and what failed.

name: Accessibility audit
prompt: Do an accessibility audit of {{URL}} (WCAG 2.2 AA). List issues with severity and suggested fixes.

name: Form validation
prompt: Find all forms on {{URL}} and test the validation with valid, empty and invalid input. Report the results as a table.
